body.zh:
英语的“是”不能省略：“我是学生” = [[I am a student.]]

代词动词缩写
[[I]][[am]][[I'm]]
[[he]] / [[she]] / [[it]][[is]][[he's]]
[[we]] / [[you]] / [[they]][[are]][[we're]]

否定：[[I am not]]，[[she isn't]]。疑问：动词放到前面：[[Are you a student?]] 形容词前也要用 be：[[I am tired.]]（我累了）

grammar.ex:
I am a student.|我是学生。
She is a doctor.|她是医生。
We are at home.|我们在家。
Are you tired?|你累吗？

title.zh: 冠词 a / the 和复数

body.zh:
[[a]]（元音前用 [[an]]）表示“一个”，用于第一次提到的单数事物：[[a book]]，[[an apple]]。[[the]] 表示特指：[[The book is on the table.]]

复数一般加 [[-s]]：[[book]] → [[books]]。不规则：[[man]] → [[men]]，[[child]] → [[children]]。

grammar.ex:
I have a dog.|我有一只狗。
The dog is big.|这只狗很大。
I eat an apple every day.|我每天吃一个苹果。
The children are in the park.|孩子们在公园里。

body.zh:
用于习惯和事实：[[I work.]]，[[We live in Beijing.]]

重要规则：主语是 he / she / it 时，动词加 [[-s]]：[[She works.]]，[[He lives here.]]

grammar.ex:
I drink tea every morning.|我每天早上喝茶。
She works in a bank.|她在银行工作。
They live near the sea.|他们住在海边。

body.zh:
否定：[[don't]] / [[doesn't]] + 动词：[[I don't eat meat.]]，[[She doesn't smoke.]]

疑问：句首用 [[Do]] / [[Does]]：[[Do you speak English?]] —— [[Yes, I do.]] / [[No, I don't.]]

doesn't 和 does 后面的动词不加 -s：[[Does he work?]]

readings.title: In My Apartment
readings.sents:
I live in an apartment in the city center.|我住在市中心的一套公寓里。
The apartment is not big, but it is bright.|公寓不大，但是很亮。
There is a bedroom, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom.|有一个卧室、一个客厅、一个厨房和一个卫生间。
In the bedroom there is a bed and a wardrobe.|卧室里有一张床和一个衣柜。
In the living room there is a sofa, a table and a TV.|客厅里有沙发、桌子和电视。
My favorite room is the kitchen.|我最喜欢的房间是厨房。
There I make breakfast and drink tea.|我在那里做早饭、喝茶。
From the window I see a park and trees.|从窗户我能看见公园和树。
My neighbors are quiet and kind.|我的邻居又安静又友好。
I really like my apartment.|我非常喜欢我的公寓。

readings.title: At the Market
readings.sents:
On Saturday I go to the market.|星期六我去市场。
There are a lot of fruits and vegetables there.|那里有很多水果和蔬菜。
I buy apples, tomatoes and cucumbers.|我买苹果、西红柿和黄瓜。
The seller is very kind.|卖东西的人很热情。
He says: "Hello! What would you like?"|他说：“你好！您要什么？”
I answer: "A kilo of grapes, please."|我回答：“请给我一公斤葡萄。”
The grapes are sweet and not expensive.|葡萄很甜，也不贵。
I also buy bread, cheese and honey.|我还买面包、奶酪和蜂蜜。
Then I go home and make a salad.|然后我回家做沙拉。

dialogues.lines:
A|Good evening! Here is the menu.|晚上好！这是菜单。
B|Thank you. What do you recommend?|谢谢。您推荐什么？
A|Today the soup is very tasty.|今天的汤非常好喝。
B|Good. Soup and a salad, please.|好。请来一份汤和一份沙拉。
A|What will you drink?|您喝什么？
B|A glass of water and tea.|一杯水和一杯茶。
A|Fine. Anything else?|好的。还要别的吗？
B|No, thank you. The bill later, please.|不用了，谢谢。等一会儿请结账。

A|Excuse me, where is the pharmacy?|请问，药店在哪儿？
B|The pharmacy is there, opposite the bank.|药店在那边，在银行对面。
A|Is it far?|远吗？
B|No, it's close. Five minutes on foot.|不远，很近。走路五分钟。
A|Should I go straight?|是一直往前走吗？
B|Yes, straight, then to the right.|对，一直往前走，然后往右拐。
A|Thank you very much!|非常感谢！
B|You're welcome!|不客气！

A|Do you have a big family?|你家人多吗？
B|Yes. I have two brothers and a sister.|多。我有两个兄弟和一个姐妹。
A|Where do they live?|他们住在哪儿？
B|My brothers live in Amman, and my sister lives here.|我的兄弟住在安曼，我的姐妹住在这里。
A|And your parents?|你父母呢？
B|My parents are also in Amman.|我父母也在安曼。
A|Do you miss them?|你想念他们吗？
B|Yes, very much. I call them every day.|很想。我每天给他们打电话。

body.zh:
规则动词加 [[-ed]]：[[work]] → [[worked]]。不规则动词要背：[[go]] → [[went]]，[[see]] → [[saw]]，[[buy]] → [[bought]]。

否定和疑问用 [[did]] + 动词原形：[[I didn't go.]]，[[Did you see it?]]

grammar.ex:
Yesterday I went to the cinema.|昨天我去看电影了。
She bought a new dress.|她买了一条新连衣裙。
Did you call your mother?|你给妈妈打电话了吗？

title.zh: 将来时：will 和 going to

body.zh:
[[going to]] 表示事先计划好的事：[[I'm going to visit London.]]

[[will]] 表示临时决定、承诺和预测：[[I'll call you later.]]，[[It will rain tomorrow.]]

grammar.ex:
I'm going to study medicine.|我打算学医。
I'll help you.|我会帮你的。
It will be sunny tomorrow.|明天会是晴天。

title.zh: 现在进行时：正在发生的事

body.zh:
[[am / is / are]] + 动词 + [[-ing]]：[[I am reading.]] = 我正在读。

比较：[[I work every day.]]（习惯）—— [[I'm working now.]]（现在）。

grammar.ex:
What are you doing?|你在做什么？
It's raining.|在下雨。
The children are playing outside.|孩子们在外面玩。

body.zh:
短形容词加 [[-er]] / [[the -est]]：[[big]] → [[bigger]] → [[the biggest]]。长形容词用 [[more]] / [[the most]]：[[more interesting]]。“比” = [[than]]：[[Beijing is bigger than London.]]

不规则：[[good]] → [[better]] → [[the best]]，[[bad]] → [[worse]] → [[the worst]]。

grammar.ex:
My brother is older than me.|我哥哥比我大。
This book is more interesting.|这本书更有意思。
It's the best day of my life.|这是我一生中最好的一天。

title.zh: 现在完成时：have + 过去分词

body.zh:
用于经历和与现在有关的结果：[[have / has]] + 过去分词：[[I have been to London.]]，[[She has lost her keys.]]

不和具体的过去时间连用：[[I saw him yesterday.]]（一般过去时），但 [[I have seen this film.]]

grammar.ex:
I have already read this book.|这本书我已经读过了。
Have you ever been to Japan?|你去过日本吗？
She has worked here for three years.|她在这里工作三年了。

body.zh:
[[can]] 能、会：[[I can swim.]]；[[must]] 必须：[[You must stop.]]；[[should]] 应该（建议）：[[You should rest.]]

情态动词后用动词原形，不加 -s，也不加 to：[[She can drive.]]

grammar.ex:
Can you help me?|你能帮我吗？
I must finish the report.|我必须完成报告。
You should see a doctor.|你应该去看医生。

title.zh: 第一条件句：if + 现在时，will

body.zh:
将来可能的条件：[[If it rains, we will stay at home.]] = 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。

if 从句里不用 will：[[If I have time…]]，不能说“If I will have”。

grammar.ex:
If I have time, I'll call you.|如果我有时间，就给你打电话。
If you study, you will pass.|如果你学习，就能通过。

Stress affects health.|压力会影响健康。
Without trust there are no good relationships.|没有信任就没有好的关系。

title.zh: 第二条件句：if + 过去时，would

body.zh:
与现在事实相反的假设：[[If I had more time, I would travel.]] = 如果我有更多时间，我就去旅行。

给建议：[[If I were you, I would accept.]] = 如果我是你，我就接受。

grammar.ex:
If I had money, I would buy a house.|如果我有钱，我就买房子。
If I were you, I would agree.|如果我是你，我就同意。

body.zh:
在过去时的 said / asked 后，时态往前推：[[“I am tired.”]] → [[She said she was tired.]]；[[“I will come.”]] → [[He said he would come.]]

间接疑问句用陈述语序：[[She asked where I worked.]]

readings.title: The City of the Future
readings.sents:
What will the city of the future be like?|未来的城市会是什么样子？
Many experts think it will have more greenery and fewer cars.|很多专家认为，那里会有更多绿地，更少汽车。
People will travel by electric cars and bicycles.|人们会开电动车、骑自行车出行。
Homes will get energy from the sun and wind.|房子会从太阳和风中获得能源。
Smart systems will control light and heat.|智能系统会控制灯光和暖气。
However, this idea also has critics.|不过，这个想法也有批评者。
They say such technologies are too expensive.|他们说这些技术太贵了。
Besides, not everyone is ready to change their habits.|而且，不是每个人都愿意改变自己的习惯。
It's hard to say who is right.|很难说谁对。
But one thing is clear: a city must be comfortable for people.|但有一点是清楚的：城市应该让人们住得舒服。

readings.title: Social Networks
readings.sents:
Social networks have become part of our lives.|社交网络已经成为我们生活的一部分。
They help us communicate with friends who live far away.|它们帮助我们和住得很远的朋友交流。
We learn the news faster than before.|我们比以前更快地知道新闻。
However, social networks also have a downside.|不过，社交网络也有不好的一面。
Many people spend several hours a day on their phones.|很多人每天花好几个小时看手机。
This affects sleep, studies and mood.|这会影响睡眠、学习和心情。
In addition, there is a lot of fake news online.|另外，网上有很多假新闻。
Psychologists advise taking breaks.|心理学家建议适当休息。
For example, you can avoid taking the phone into the bedroom.|比如，可以不把手机带进卧室。
The main thing is to remember that life doesn't happen on a screen.|最重要的是记住，生活不是在屏幕上。

readings.title: Volunteers
readings.sents:
My friend Anya volunteers at an animal shelter.|我的朋友安娅在动物收容所当志愿者。
She goes there every Saturday.|她每个星期六都去那里。
Anya feeds the dogs, walks them and cleans.|安娅喂狗、遛狗，还打扫卫生。
She is not paid money for this.|她做这些不拿钱。
But she says she gets much more — joy.|但她说她得到的更多，那就是快乐。
Thanks to volunteers, many animals find a new home.|多亏了志愿者，很多动物找到了新家。
Last month Anya talked me into it too.|上个月安娅也说服了我。
Now we go there together.|现在我们一起去。
I realized that helping others is happiness.|我明白了，帮助别人就是幸福。

A|Such as?|比如？

B|So we agree.|那就这么定了。

B|I agree with that. But the plot was too predictable.|这一点我同意。但是情节太好猜了。

B|Deal!|一言为定！

Innovation is the engine of the economy.|创新是经济的发动机。
Management met us halfway.|领导层对我们作出了让步。
We need to reduce costs.|我们必须降低成本。
The results of the year exceeded expectations.|今年的结果超出了预期。
He has a broad outlook.|他视野很开阔。
Her speech was clear and logical.|她的发言清楚而有逻辑。
I find it hard to agree with you.|我很难同意您的看法。
Allow me to express my point of view.|请允许我表达我的观点。

She set to work with enthusiasm.|她满怀热情地投入了工作。

His contribution to science can hardly be overestimated.|他对科学的贡献怎么评价都不过分。
As technology develops, society changes too.|随着技术的发展，社会也在变化。

His act cannot be justified.|他的行为无法辩解。
We encountered unforeseen difficulties.|我们遇到了意想不到的困难。
Such cases are not rare.|这样的情况并不少见。
His views have changed over time.|随着时间的推移，他的观点变了。
She has always had a sense of humor.|她一直很有幽默感。
I value your opinion highly.|我非常重视您的意见。
This topic requires a separate discussion.|这个话题需要单独讨论。
The survey results turned out to be unexpected.|调查结果出人意料。
We proceed from the assumption that all participants agree.|我们假定所有参与者都同意。
These two phenomena are closely related.|这两种现象密切相关。

Life is not just work.|生活不只是工作。
His conscience did not allow him to lie.|他的良心不允许他撒谎。
Wisdom comes with experience.|智慧来自经验。

Urbanization leads to the growth of cities.|城市化导致城市扩大。
Digitalization has affected all spheres of life.|数字化影响了生活的各个领域。
Cybersecurity is becoming more and more relevant.|网络安全变得越来越重要。
Population aging is a challenge for the economy.|人口老龄化是对经济的挑战。
Tolerance is the basis of peaceful coexistence.|宽容是和平共处的基础。
Without developed infrastructure, growth is impossible.|没有完善的基础设施，就不可能发展。
The reform received a mixed reception.|这项改革引起了不同的反应。
Civil society plays an important role.|公民社会发挥着重要作用。
Discrimination is unacceptable.|歧视是不能接受的。
The economic downturn affected many industries.|经济衰退影响了许多行业。
The literacy of the population is constantly growing.|人口的识字率在不断提高。
Experts differ in their opinions.|专家们意见不一。

body.zh:
[[who]] 指人，[[which]] 指物，[[that]] 两者都可以，[[whose]] 表示“……的”：[[The woman who called is my aunt.]]，[[The book which I bought…]]，[[the man whose car…]]

关系词作宾语时可以省略：[[the book I read]] = 我读的书。

grammar.ex:
The student who passed the exam is happy.|通过考试的学生很高兴。
This is the city where I was born.|这是我出生的城市。
I have a friend whose father is a pilot.|我有一个朋友，他爸爸是飞行员。
quiz: the man whose car is red
the man who car is red
the man which car is red

body.zh:
与过去事实相反的假设：[[If I had known, I would have told you.]] = 要是我早知道，就告诉你了。

[[I wish]] + 过去时 = 但愿：[[I wish I spoke Chinese.]]（要是我会说中文就好了。）

readings.title: Reading in the Digital Age
readings.sents:
Lately many people complain that people have stopped reading.|最近很多人抱怨，说大家不再读书了。
However, research shows a more complex picture.|然而，研究显示情况更加复杂。
We read no less than before, but we read differently.|我们读得并不比以前少，只是读的方式不同了。
Texts have become shorter, and attention more scattered.|文本变短了，注意力也更分散了。
Thus, it is not the quantity but the depth of reading that suffers.|因此，受到影响的不是阅读的数量，而是深度。
Scientists emphasize that the ability to concentrate is a skill.|科学家强调，集中注意力的能力是一种技能。
Like any skill, it needs to be trained.|和任何技能一样，它需要训练。
For example, it is useful to read paper books without a phone nearby.|比如，读纸质书时不把手机放在身边很有好处。
On the whole, digital technologies are not harmful in themselves.|总的来说，数字技术本身并没有害处。
Everything depends on how we use them.|一切都取决于我们怎样使用它们。

readings.title: Sustainable Development
readings.sents:
The concept of sustainable development appeared at the end of the twentieth century.|可持续发展的概念出现于二十世纪末。
Its essence is simple: meet today's needs without harming future generations.|它的本质很简单：满足今天的需求，而不损害子孙后代。
However, in practice this turned out to be much more difficult.|然而，在实践中这要困难得多。
Economic growth often contradicts environmental protection.|经济增长常常与环境保护相矛盾。
Nevertheless, many countries are introducing "green" technologies.|尽管如此，许多国家正在推行“绿色”技术。
Companies also take environmental factors into account.|企业也在考虑环境因素。
Undoubtedly, without the participation of each of us there will be no success.|毫无疑问，没有我们每个人的参与就不会成功。

readings.title: The Art of Arguing
readings.sents:
The ability to argue is one of the most important in the modern world.|善于辩论是现代世界最重要的能力之一。
The goal of an argument is not to defeat the other person but to get closer to the truth.|辩论的目的不是战胜对方，而是接近真理。
First of all, you need to listen carefully to your opponent.|首先，要认真听对方说话。
Then you should give arguments, not emotions.|然后要拿出论据，而不是情绪。
It is important to distinguish facts from opinions.|重要的是把事实和观点区分开。
If you are wrong, admit it — it's a sign of strength, not weakness.|如果你错了，就承认——这是强大的表现，不是软弱。
Ultimately, a good argument enriches both sides.|归根结底，好的辩论让双方都有收获。

dialogues.lines:
A|How do you assess the impact of artificial intelligence on the labor market?|您怎样评价人工智能对劳动市场的影响？
B|On the one hand, it automates routine tasks.|一方面，它让日常工作自动化。
B|On the other hand, new professions are emerging.|另一方面，新的职业正在出现。
A|But not everyone will manage to retrain.|但是不是每个人都来得及转行。
B|That's exactly why the state should invest in education.|正因为如此，国家应该投资教育。
A|I agree, but it takes time.|我同意，但这需要时间。
B|Certainly. That's why we must start today.|当然。所以必须从今天开始。

A|I suggest we move on to the main issue.|我建议我们来谈谈主要问题。
B|Yes, let's discuss the terms of the contract.|好，我们讨论一下合同的条件。
A|The delivery terms do not suit us.|交货期限我们不满意。
B|We can shorten them by a week.|我们可以缩短一个星期。
A|And what about the price?|那么价格呢？
B|For a large order we are ready to provide a discount.|大订单我们可以给折扣。
A|In that case we can sign the agreement.|这样的话我们可以签协议。
B|Excellent. I'll prepare the documents by tomorrow.|太好了。我明天之前准备好文件。

A|What book are you reading now?|您现在在看什么书？
B|I'm rereading "Crime and Punishment".|我在重读《罪与罚》。
A|Isn't it too gloomy?|不是太阴郁了吗？
B|Gloomy, but deep. Every time I find something new.|阴郁，但是深刻。每次我都能发现新东西。
A|What attracts you most in it?|书里最吸引您的是什么？
B|The psychology of the characters and the eternal questions about conscience.|人物的心理和关于良心的永恒问题。
A|Perhaps I should reread it too.|也许我也该重读一下。

She remained steadfast in her convictions.|她始终坚守自己的信念。

His smugness irritated his colleagues.|他的自鸣得意让同事们很恼火。
In this choice there are neither right nor wrong.|在这个选择中，没有对也没有错。
The future is shrouded in uncertainty.|未来笼罩在不确定性之中。
Diversity of opinion is a wealth.|观点的多样性是一种财富。
This book is the fruit of many years of work.|这本书是多年心血的结晶。
The poet's words sound new.|诗人的话听起来很新鲜。
One thought gives me no peace.|有一个念头让我不得安宁。
Fame did not spoil him.|名声没有宠坏他。
We corresponded for a long time.|我们通信了很长时间。
The will to live is stronger than fear.|求生的意志比恐惧更强大。
They miraculously avoided disaster.|他们奇迹般地避免了灾难。
His speech abounded in quotations.|他的讲话里引文很多。
Perhaps it was for the best.|也许这样反而更好。
Time will tell.|时间会证明一切。
His zeal knew no bounds.|他的热忱没有止境。
Everything in this world is transient.|世间万物都是短暂的。
Her patience ran out.|她的耐心用完了。
She unraveled his plan.|她识破了他的计划。
Having weighed all the pros and cons, he refused.|权衡了利弊之后，他拒绝了。
A strange premonition came over me.|一种奇怪的预感涌上我的心头。
In the twilight the city looked ghostly.|黄昏中，城市显得如幽灵一般。
Happiness is fleeting, like spring rain.|幸福像春雨一样转瞬即逝。
His taste was distinguished by refinement.|他的品味十分精致。
Compassion is not weakness.|怜悯不是软弱。
She confided her innermost thoughts to him.|她向他倾诉了内心深处的想法。
All his efforts proved futile.|他所有的努力都白费了。
We bow before his talent.|我们敬佩他的才华。
A pre-dawn silence fell.|黎明前一片寂静。
He chose his path in youth.|他年轻时就选择了自己的道路。
The chronicle preserves the memory of those events.|编年史保存着那些事件的记忆。
Our job is to do our duty.|我们的职责就是尽到责任。
This book is an intricate web of fates.|这本书是命运交织的一张网。
His speech was chaotic.|他的讲话杂乱无章。
He had an epiphany.|他突然醒悟了。
Beauty will save the world.|美将拯救世界。
Life is not a walk in the park.|人生不是一帆风顺的。
Better late than never.|迟到总比不到好。
A drowning man clutches at a straw.|溺水的人连一根稻草也要抓。
There's no smoke without fire.|无风不起浪。
Business before pleasure.|先工作，后娱乐。
A friend in need is a friend indeed.|患难见真情。
Strength lies in truth.|力量在于真理。

body.zh:
动词 + 小品词构成新意思：[[give up]]（放弃），[[look after]]（照顾），[[turn down]]（拒绝），[[get over]]（克服）。

习语要整体记：[[Better late than never.]]，[[A friend in need is a friend indeed.]]

grammar.ex:
Don't give up!|别放弃！
She turned down the offer.|她拒绝了这个提议。
Better late than never.|迟到总比不到好。

body.zh:
在正式文体中，否定词放在句首时，助动词要放在主语前：[[Never have I seen such beauty.]]，[[Not only did he come, but he also helped.]]

[[No sooner had he arrived than…]] = 他一到就……

grammar.ex:
Never have I seen such a beautiful city.|我从来没见过这么美的城市。
Not only did he come, but he also helped.|他不但来了，还帮了忙。

quiz.zh: “我从来没见过这样的东西”（正式）：

quiz: Never have I seen such a thing.
Never I have seen such a thing.
Never seen I have such a thing.

readings.title: The Art of Silence
readings.sents:
They say that speech is silver, but silence is gold.|人们常说：言语是银，沉默是金。
In the age of endless messages, this proverb sounds almost like a challenge.|在消息无穷无尽的时代，这句谚语几乎像一种挑战。
We rush to answer, comment, have our say.|我们急于回复、评论、表态。
And rarely wonder whether it was worth it.|却很少问自己这样做是否值得。
Meanwhile, the ability to keep silent at the right moment is a sign not of weakness but of maturity.|然而，在恰当的时候保持沉默是成熟的标志，而不是软弱。
Silence gives time to make sense of what was heard.|沉默给我们时间去思考听到的话。
It turns out that listening is no less important than speaking.|原来，倾听和说话同样重要。
It is no coincidence that sages of all ages valued taciturnity.|难怪古往今来的智者都重视少言。

readings.title: On Translation
readings.sents:
Translation is not a simple replacement of words.|翻译不是简单地替换词语。
Every language holds within itself a special vision of the world.|每一种语言都包含着独特的世界观。
Idioms, wordplay, subtext — all this is hard to translate.|成语、文字游戏、潜台词——这些都很难翻译。
A translator has to choose between accuracy and beauty.|译者不得不在准确和优美之间做出选择。
No wonder they say a translator is a co-author.|难怪人们说译者是合著者。
A good translation preserves not only the meaning but also the spirit of the original.|好的翻译不仅保留意思，还保留原作的精神。
That is precisely why great books are translated again and again.|正因为如此，伟大的书一再被重新翻译。

readings.title: The Memory of a Place
readings.sents:
There are cities that live in us long after we have left them.|有些城市在我们离开很久之后仍然活在我们心里。
The smell of rain on an old street, the ringing of bells, the voice of a merchant at the market.|老街上雨的气味、钟声、市场上商贩的吆喝声。
All this suddenly surfaces in memory.|这一切会突然浮现在记忆中。
Nostalgia is not just longing for the past.|怀旧不只是对过去的思念。
It is an attempt to bring back a part of yourself that stayed there.|它是想找回留在那里的一部分自己。
Returning there years later, we often recognize neither the city nor ourselves.|多年以后回到那里，我们常常既认不出那座城市，也认不出自己。
And yet this meeting gives a strange serenity.|然而，这次重逢会带来一种奇特的宁静。

dialogues.lines:
A|So, did you finish the novel?|怎么样，小说看完了吗？
B|I did. Honestly, the ending baffled me.|看完了。说实话，结局让我很困惑。
A|Yes, the author likes to leave things unsaid.|是啊，作者喜欢留白。
B|Exactly. Everything rests on the subtext.|没错。一切都靠潜台词。
A|But what language! I couldn't put it down.|但是语言多么美啊！我都放不下。
B|That's true, no arguing.|这倒是，没得说。

A|Are you still offended with me?|你还在生我的气吗？
B|Not so much offended as disappointed.|与其说生气，不如说失望。
A|I understand. I lost my temper and said too much.|我明白。我一时冲动，说多了。
B|A word is not a sparrow; once it flies out, you can't catch it.|说出去的话，泼出去的水。
A|I know. Please forgive me.|我知道。请原谅我。
B|All right, let bygones be bygones.|好吧，过去的就让它过去吧。
A|Thank you. You're a true friend.|谢谢。你是真正的朋友。

A|What do you say about this canvas?|你觉得这幅画怎么样？
B|The colors are striking, but the composition is overloaded, in my opinion.|色彩很惊人，但我觉得构图太满了。
A|And I think that's exactly the artist's intention.|我倒觉得这正是画家的用意。
B|Possibly. Chaos as a reflection of the era?|有可能。用混乱来反映时代？
A|Exactly. Look at the brushstrokes — how much anxiety there is in them.|正是。你看这些笔触——里面有多少不安。
B|You've almost convinced me.|你差不多说服我了。
